page.overview:
Who is Aether?

Aether was an elemental Protogenoi the upper air that the gods of Olympus breathe. He was the son of Erebos and Nyx.

Aether the personification of the upper light, or the air of the gods. He was also the personification of the bright light that shone from his sister, Hemera, goddess of day and daylight.

According to legend, during the daytime, Aether's bright body shone all over the world. But at night, Nyx came out of her home in Tartarus and drew Erebos over Aether to cover him up. Erebos would make it night time and Aether would be covered up. After Nyx went back to her home, Hemera would emerge and scatter Erebos to let Aether show and let it be day again.

Category:Sky Gods Category:Males Category:Deities
